reads.AORT: mixed — a real FY26 earnings reset and stent-graft miss offset by rapidly rising absolute EBITDA, share gains, and a decompressing forward multiple.
reads.BRBR: strongly-bearish — margin fell in both percent AND absolute EBITDA on broad cost/competitive pressure, with consensus still cutting and leverage elevated; repair unproven.
reads.CNXC: mixed — a real $1.5B impairment and rising leverage sit against stable dollar EBITDA, positive FCF, and an unproven but inflecting AI mix-shift.
reads.EPAM: mixed — net-cash self-funding and residual-looking peer discount offset a management-owned North America shortfall with 16/16 downward revenue revisions.
reads.FUBO: mixed — a genuine post-combination EBITDA turn and constructive targets sit against a large ongoing cash burn, forward-EBITDA premium, and decaying near-term consensus.
reads.IT: mixed — a floor-level multiple on still-growing absolute EBITDA and intact retention, offset by genuinely stalling revenue and ex-Fed new-business declines.
reads.MVST: strongly-bearish — management-stated going-concern doubt plus a ~$104M twelve-month maturity wall against thin cash and falling volume dominate the optical cheapness.
reads.NCNO: mixed — trailing metrics look terminal (154x P/E, laggard, insider selling) but forward multiples, rising EBITDA and live AI consumption argue overshoot; delivery of the ramp is the crux.
reads.NFLX: mixed — durable, self-funding compounding with a large stated runway, but a premium multiple, negative consensus breadth and soft view-hour volume set expectations that must be beaten.
reads.SMPL: mixed — a cash-generative, low-leverage business at its own valuation floor, but with two of three brands in real decline and estimates still being cut.
reads.UBER: strongly-bullish — volume-led bookings growth with segment operating income compounding 28–40% and >$10B LTM FCF; the bear case is mostly optical/GAAP-EPS timing.
reads.V: strongly-bullish — core volume still compounding ($4T, +10% cc) with faster-growing VAS and rising ROIC, though the durability is largely priced in.
reads.VITL: mixed — a violent event-driven EBITDA collapse and cash burn set against an intact balance sheet, loyal base, and early, mechanism-specific recovery evidence.
reads.VRRM: mixed — a genuine high-margin, self-funding Government-Solutions engine offset by a quantified >10%-customer loss and a still-falling forward EBITDA base.
